name: OSS_CONSOLIDATED_REMINDERS_T
description: This table stores the information of eligible Subscription for consolidated reminder.

columns.name: REMINDER_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier. Primary key column of the table.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Subscription Id.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: User language code

columns.name: QUOTE_TO_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Quote to contact id.

columns.name: QUOTE_TO_COPY_TO_EMAIL
columns.description: CC email address for quote to contact

columns.name: SENDER_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Sender email address

columns.name: COMMUNICATION_CHANNEL
columns.description: Communication channel used for consolidated reminder.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEMPLATE
columns.description: Message template used for consolidated reminder.

columns.name: MESSAGE_SUBJECT
columns.description: Subject of email

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_TEMPLATE
columns.description: Attachment template used for consolidated reminder.

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_NAME
columns.description: Attach file name

columns.name: CONSOLIDATE_REMINDER_GROUP
columns.description: Rank of consolidation reminder group

columns.name: REMINDER_STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicat the reminder notification process status.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
